title: GridKit case
description: A case: document header, system model parameters, a flat set of model instances with their wiring, the operating point, and output sinks. This schema owns the envelope; class-specific rules (port, parameter, and monitor names and types) come from the model specs (model.schema.json).

format_version.description: Case format version this document is written against.

date_time.description: ISO 8601 datetime associated with the case.

description.description: What is modeled in the case.

models.description: Model instances: name to instance. Map keys are the identities wiring and init refer to, so names are unique by construction.

init.description: Operating point: instance/port to initial value (b1/vr). The models are structure; init is state — swap operating points without touching the models.

output.description: Output sinks for monitored variables. Omitted means default CSV to stdout.

ref.description: An instance (b1) or an instance's port (gen/speed).

instance.description: One use of a model class.

wiring.description: Own port to its source: a bus terminal takes a bus instance (bus: b1), an input takes another instance's output (pmech: gov/pmech). Keys are own inputs and bus terminals, so every input has one source by construction; an omitted input is held constant.

parameters.description: Parameter values; names and types per the class's spec. An omitted parameter assumes its typical value.

monitors.description: What to record: input and output variables and derived monitors of this class, by name.
